definitions.gloss: more, all the more, even more
definitions.explanation: To an even greater degree than before.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}{努力|どりょく}します。
{雨|あめ}で{一層|いっそう}{寒|さむ}くなった。
examples.english: The rain made it even colder.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一層|いっそう}{美|うつく}しく{見|み}えた。

notes:
{一層|いっそう} emphasizes an increase in degree.

USAGE:
- Formal/literary compared to もっと
- Often used in writing and formal speech
- Emphasizes intensification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もっと: more (conversational, common)
- さらに: furthermore, additionally
- {一層|いっそう}: all the more (formal, emphatic)
